response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT site.riskeval, AVG(scan.gbsize / NULLIF(scan.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS scan JOIN sites AS site ON site.zoneregistry = scan.zoneref GROUP BY site.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate

assumptions.assumption: A zero-minute duration has an undefined GB-per-minute rate, so that scan is ignored when calculating its group rate.
